jobs.arrival: You're deciding whether to build your next small content site on cairn-cms instead of the stack you already know, and you want a straight answer before you spend a weekend on it.
jobs.job: Read what you have access to and form your own verdict: what cairn is actually for, what it deliberately leaves out, and what running a site on it would cost you and a co-editor day to day. Note anything that reads like marketing rather than a real claim, and anything left unclear. You're done once you can state whether you'd prototype on cairn or not, and the one or two reasons that decided it. Quote the exact lines you relied on, with their file path and line number, the way your Read tool shows them.

You're done once you can name which condition (if any) `cairn doctor` reported and what the matching page told you to do about it.
